summary: Frontend-only validation of the new 'Cotización Equipos Infra' interceptor flow in CRM MegaNexus. Config UI (Configuración de otras Acciones) and the runtime modal logic in Quotes.jsx were validated end-to-end through Playwright with route-level network mocking (POST /send-to-client and POST /equipos-infra were mocked to avoid sending real emails; GET /api/quotes was patched to flip one quote's client_segment to 'CORP' so the same React state path used in production is exercised). ALL 6 acceptance criteria PASSED.

issues: Repeated React hydration warning <span> child of <tr>/<tbody> (cosmetic, carried over from iter 21-22)
Multiple DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning, carried over)

critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.jsx proceedSendToClient (L2427-2445) correctly: (a) finds the quote in state, (b) checks client_segment.toUpperCase()==='CORP', (c) GETs /other-actions/configs/cotizacion_equipos_infra, (d) opens equipos-infra-modal only when exists!==false AND enabled!==false AND recipients.length>0, otherwise calls executeSendToClient directly — verified by the three scenarios (PYME, CORP_DISABLED, CORP enabled).

handleEquiposInfraAnswer (L2449-2463): on 'Sí' it awaits POST /quotes/{id}/equipos-infra and then dispatches; on 'No' it only dispatches — verified by network capture (CORP_YES → both calls; CORP_NO → only send-to-client).

OtherActionsConfig card for 'cotizacion_equipos_infra' renders all required data-testid (toggle, enabled, add-row, save, oa-row-kind/email/tpl). Existing persisted config (infra-to@/cc@/bcc@megasoft.com.ve + plantilla 'Envío de Cotización a Cliente (Sede P...)') was loaded correctly on expand.
Note: the failsafe try/catch in proceedSendToClient (config GET failure → fallback to direct send) is correctly placed; recommend logging the failure for observability (currently swallowed silently).
Pre-existing: <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <tr>/<tbody> hydration warnings; review the dev-toolbar wrapper component to use a row-safe element.
seed_data_creation: None on backend. In the UI test, POST /send-to-client and POST /equipos-infra were intercepted with route.fulfill() — no real emails were sent and no quote state was actually modified in the DB. Existing 'cotizacion_equipos_infra' config (TO/CC/BCC infra-{to,cc,bcc}@megasoft.com.ve with template 'quote_sent_PYME' / 'Envío de Cotización a Cliente (Sede P...)') was used as the persisted source for the GET in the enabled scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows validated with route-mocked sends to prevent email side-effects. To re-test in a 'live' way: the referenced CORP quote COT-2026-05-001-CORP (quo_6b5d5dd86fe0) was NOT visible in rgonzalez's /quotes list (segment filter 'Corporativo' returned 0 rows even though backend reports the quote exists). If a true live CORP run is desired, the main agent should (a) create or surface a CORP quote in a sendable state visible to admin, and (b) run an end-to-end UI flow without route interception. For pure frontend regression of the modal logic, this iteration's three-scenario Playwright pattern (PYME_no_patch / CORP_YES / CORP_DISABLED + earlier CORP_NO) is sufficient.

validated_acceptance_criteria.A_config_ui: PASS — Card expandable via [data-testid=oa-action-toggle-cotizacion_equipos_infra]; toggle enabled (aria-checked=true) at [data-testid=oa-action-enabled-cotizacion_equipos_infra]; Agregar Fila and Guardar testids present; 3 persisted rows render with oa-row-kind-*, oa-row-email-*, oa-row-tpl-* (TO/CC/BCC + plantilla).
validated_acceptance_criteria.B_pyme_no_modal: PASS — On a PYME quote, after contact-select-modal → Continuar in Personalizar Comunicación, equipos-infra-modal count = 0; POST /send-to-client fired (1), POST /equipos-infra fired (0).
validated_acceptance_criteria.C_corp_modal_appears: PASS — With patched CORP segment + enabled config + recipients>0, equipos-infra-modal appeared after Continuar; both [data-testid=equipos-infra-yes] and [data-testid=equipos-infra-no] are present.
validated_acceptance_criteria.D_corp_no_answer: PASS — Clicking [data-testid=equipos-infra-no] → POST /send-to-client fired (1), POST /equipos-infra fired (0).
validated_acceptance_criteria.E_corp_yes_answer: PASS — Clicking [data-testid=equipos-infra-yes] → POST /send-to-client fired (1) AND POST /equipos-infra fired (1) (mock returned dispatched:true).
validated_acceptance_criteria.F_disabled_no_modal: PASS — With GET /other-actions/configs/cotizacion_equipos_infra mocked to {enabled:false, recipients:[]} on a CORP quote, equipos-infra-modal count = 0 and quote dispatched directly via POST /send-to-client.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration; all acceptance criteria for the new 'Cotización Equipos Infra' interceptor flow passed.
